```plato
    //==
    // # Direction2D / Direction3D — validated factories (normalization pitfalls)
    //
    // Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Partial operations. `FromVector`
    // normalizes and carries a non-zero precondition; `TryFromVector` is the
    // total fallback form; `FromVectorUnchecked` wraps without normalizing and is
    // only correct when the argument is already unit length.

    // The unit direction of v. Precondition: v is non-zero (its length becomes the
    // divisor); zero input is undefined. Use TryFromVector for a total path.
    FromVector(v: Vector2D): Direction2D
        => Direction2D(v.Normalize);
```
